en: A colorized historical postcard showing a large baroque fountain topped with a statue of Neptune in a town square, surrounded by old multi‑story buildings with arched porticoes and shuttered windows. A domed building rises in the background, and a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk near the fountain. The caption at the top right reads "Trento - Fontana e Casa Rella."
